title: 1.5kW Lithium Solar Power Combo Without Panels | UTL Gamma 1650 1400VA Solar PCU + 12.8V 100Ah LiFePO4 Battery + Heavy Duty GI Structure for 3 Solar Panels
description: This Gamma Pro (3P) is a premium solar power combo designed for homes, shops and small offices seeking dependable backup with the latest lithium battery technology. This combo includes the trusted UTL Gamma 1650 1400VA Solar PCU, a 12.8V 100Ah LiFePO4 Lithium Battery and a Solarware Heavy Duty GI Rooftop Structure engineered to support three solar panels. The advanced rMPPT Solar PCU maximizes solar energy utilization while delivering clean Pure Sine Wave output for household appliances. The maintenance-free lithium battery offers fast charging, longer backup and extended service life with intelligent BMS protection. To provide greater flexibility and better value, solar panels are intentionally not included. Customers can continue using their existing panels or choose compatible panels later based on their preferred brand, wattage and budget. Installation Instructions> * Installation should only be carried out by a qualified electrician or solar installation professional. * Ensure the rooftop structure is securely anchored before mounting solar panels. * Follow all local electrical and safety regulations during installation. * Verify battery polarity, wiring and grounding before powering on the system. * Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including insulated gloves, safety footwear and eye protection. * Professional installation is strongly recommended for safe operation, optimum performance and warranty compliance.

specifications.Included Components: Solar Panel Structure for 3 Panels, UTL Gamma 1650 Solar PCU & 12.8V Lithium Battery
